content.short: Secure3 provides security audits for blockchain-based projects.
content.description: Secure3 runs audit contests to deliver affordable, efficient, and secure Web3 audits. Several prominent Web3 projects rely on Secure3, including OKX, ZettaBlock, BitMart, and zkSync. The audit process unfolds in three steps: first, projects define the scope, timeline, and budget for the audit; second, Secure3 runs and oversees a contest in which qualified auditors compete to identify vulnerabilities; third, Secure3 delivers the final audit report.
